metadata.description: LeoTrace security plugins for coding agents.

plugins.name: leoprevent
plugins.description: For macOS and Linux. Reviews Cursor Agent changes and requests a follow-up when security findings need attention. Requires a LeoTrace account; changed code is sent to LeoTrace for review.

plugins.name: leoprevent-windows
plugins.description: For Windows. Reviews Cursor Agent changes and requests a follow-up when security findings need attention. Requires a LeoTrace account; changed code is sent to LeoTrace for review.
